861:t_048:6.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Now then, a letter from one of the good kids playing SRW, a big SRW fan in Aichi Prefecture...」

861:t_048:7.en:
$$カズミ$$
「We received a postcard asking, 'What is the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ that appeared starting this time?'」

861:t_048:8.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$タカヤ$$, what do you know about the $$Ｚクリスタル$$?」

861:t_048:9.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's a dimensional force activation system that affects the entire unit, right? And with $$Ｚチップ$$, you can power it up in all sorts of directions!」

861:t_048:10.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Close, but no. The $$Ｚクリスタル$$ can do more than just that. Its power will be revealed as you progress through the game.」

861:t_049:7.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
「Is it nice to play with someone?」

861:t_049:9.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
「Would you be happy if I played in your place...?」

861:t_049:10.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Huh...! That's... going a bit too far...」

861:t_050:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Hey, how can I get better at playing?」

861:t_050:4.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Repetition is all it takes. Run the same stage over and over.」

861:t_050:5.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Until you reach a level and funds that let you play comfortably. There's no other way.」

861:t_050:6.en:
$$カヲル$$
「But for now, rest comes first.」

861:t_050:7.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Huh... But I was just starting to get the hang of it...」

861:t_050:8.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Don't make that face. You can resume any time, $$シンジ$$.」

861:t_050:9.en:
$$カヲル$$
「As long as the players want the world to go on. Until then, we part for a little while.」

861:t_050:10.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Good night, $$カヲル$$. And good night to all you players, too.」

861:t_051:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Playing SRW like this with you, $$カヲル$$, was fun in a way it hasn't been in a long time.」

861:t_051:4.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Me too, $$シンジ$$. I'd like to play with you again.」

861:t_051:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「But... is it really okay? All you do is watch me play, $$カヲル$$.」

861:t_051:6.en:
$$カヲル$$
「SRW is a single-player game, after all. But just watching is plenty of fun.」

861:t_051:8.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Because I was born to meet you.」

861:t_052:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$綾波$$, if you're free, want to play SRW together?」

861:t_052:4.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「If it is an order, I will.」

861:t_052:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「No, it's not like it's an order...」

861:t_052:7.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「In a situation like this, what would $$アヤナミレイ$$ do?」

861:t_052:8.en:
$$シンジ$$
「What... do you want to do?」

861:t_053:3.en:
$$アスカ$$
「What? You're pausing the game here~!? It was just getting good!」

861:t_053:5.en:
$$マリ$$
「My bad! I'm short on sleep, so I'm off first. Leaving the player in your hands, Princess~, thaaanks!」

861:t_053:7.en:
$$アスカ$$
「F-fine, it can't be helped! You can take a break too, but you'd better come back, you hear me!」

861:t_054:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I see, it ends here, then... I had hoped to enjoy 'Super Robot Wars' with you a little longer...」

861:t_054:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Heh... Is it troubling for you to hear this from me?」

861:t_054:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「But even I have nights when I want someone at my side.」

861:t_054:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Someday, I hope I can fight alongside you.」

861:t_054:7.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Until we meet again, then, strong players.」

861:t_055:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Pausing here is a good call. Fatigue breeds careless mistakes.」

861:t_055:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'd like you to resume after a good rest, but first I have a word of advice.」

861:t_055:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Tag battles are the basis of the fighting this time, and the key is the combination of the two units teamed up.」

861:t_055:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Find a comrade you can trust from the heart... or a rival, and raise each other's strength.」

861:t_055:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Then I'll be waiting for your return on the battlefield.」

861:t_056:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Pausing here is a good call. Fatigue breeds careless mistakes.」

861:t_056:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'd like you to resume after a good rest, but first let me tell you something useful.」

861:t_056:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「When a pilot who has become an ace joins the $$Ｄトレーダー$$, something happens...」

861:t_056:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Find the answer through your own play. Until we meet again.」

861:t_057:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Good work, $$バナージ$$. Are you enjoying 'Super Robot Wars'?」

861:t_057:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「About that... I just can't get the hang of the $$ユニコーン$$'s Destroy Mode...」

861:t_057:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I wonder how you get the $$ユニコーン$$'s horn... to split open...」

861:t_057:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If it's the knack for cracking something open on top of your head you want, ask $$シン$$ or $$キラ$$.」

861:t_057:8.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Who knows... Once you get a little more used to the game, you'll understand.」

861:t_058:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「It's something one hates to admit... the follies of one's own youth...」

861:t_058:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「Even the man who once said that grew up as time passed, and changed.」

861:t_058:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「But even as the times change, some things never change.」

861:t_058:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「'Super Robot Wars'... and the passion of its players...」

861:t_058:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「I too believe that people with that kind of fire will protect the Earth.」

861:t_059:3.en:
$$クェス$$
「Why are you stopping just when it's getting good! Keep going, you!」

861:t_059:4.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Don't be unreasonable, $$クェス$$. If you don't get proper rest, it's bad for your body.」

861:t_059:6.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Because my family is always nagging me. They say it's all for nothing if you wreck your health, right?」

861:t_059:7.en:
$$クェス$$
「I see, so that's one way of looking at it... Yeah, maybe you're right!」

861:t_059:8.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Then let's say goodbye. Say 'See you again'!」

861:t_059:9.en:
$$クェス$$
「Make sure you come back, darling! Promise!」

861:t_060:3.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Save complete. Shall we end the game... Captain?」

861:t_060:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「That decision is left to the player. We stand by so we can respond to whatever they decide.」

861:t_060:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「The fighting isn't over yet. This is only a brief respite.」
